name: How long does a basement door installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a basement door installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing a standard interior basement door usually takes half a day to a full day. If your project involves framing a new opening through an unfinished wall, adjusting structural framing, or adding drywall patching and trim carpentry, the job can take two to three days to finish completely. Working with an owner-operated finish carpentry team means one crew handles the rough framing, drywall repairs, and final trim installation seamlessly. Paint or stain finishing can also add drying time to the final schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: A straightforward door replacement takes half a day to a day, while creating a new framed opening with drywall and trim takes two to three days.
